title: 前董事称：SpaceX营收380亿，远超公开数据？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I am curious about, sort of, you know, what you think. Elon is going to try to articulate on this conference call, a money-looting, losing business.
segments.zh: 我很好奇，你觉得埃隆会在这次电话会议上如何阐述这个亏损的业务。

segments.en: But obviously, a ton of potential up ahead for what this business can be.
segments.zh: 但显然，这项业务未来潜力巨大。

segments.en: There is a salesmanship job that has to go on, not just today, but probably over the next few months in quarters.
segments.zh: 不仅今天，未来几个月甚至几个季度都需要进行推销。

segments.en: You think he's going to be able to do it? Well, he's a pretty darn good salesman with a pretty strong track record.
segments.zh: 你觉得他能做到吗？嗯，他是个相当出色的推销员，业绩记录也很强。

segments.en: Then look, I think this is going to be high-drama because the share price down 13% from the IPO, but down 50% from his peak.
segments.zh: 我认为这将充满戏剧性，因为股价较IPO下跌13%，但较峰值下跌50%。

segments.en: So they've got their work cut out for them. I think what they're going to argue here is, look, they're an incredible growth engine that SpaceX contract that doubled from $18.7 billion.
segments.zh: 所以他们面临艰巨任务。我认为他们会辩称，他们是一个惊人的增长引擎，SpaceX合同从187亿美元翻倍。

segments.en: 2025, this year looks like they're going to hit $38 billion.
segments.zh: 2025年，今年看起来他们将达到380亿美元。

segments.en: And I think he's going to say, well, probably going to double again next year.
segments.zh: 我认为他会说，明年可能会再次翻倍。

segments.en: He's going to focus on being a market leader. SpaceX is dominant and launched 51% of all launches in the world are SpaceX craft.
segments.zh: 他将专注于成为市场领导者。SpaceX占据主导地位，全球51%的发射都是SpaceX的航天器。

segments.en: He's got a good growth story. But I think investors are going to walk away with three questions.
segments.zh: 他的增长故事不错，但市场参与者会带着三个问题离开。

segments.en: How quickly can SpaceX and Starlink continue to grow?
segments.zh: SpaceX和星链能多快继续增长？

segments.en: Can SpaceX AI really break in with the big boys and thropic open AI and Google?
I think they can, but that's going to be heavy lifting.
segments.zh: 我认为可以，但这需要付出巨大努力。
